name: METR-LA: Traffic Speed Forecasting Dataset
description: METR-LA is a spatio-temporal benchmark for traffic speed forecasting. It contains highway traffic speed readings aggregated into 5-minute intervals from 207 loop detector sensors installed across Los Angeles County highways from March 1, 2012 to June 30, 2012 (34,272 time steps), accompanied by sensor topology road network distance graphs.
